product.name: Loose Fit Printed Sweatshirt
product.description: Loose-fit sweatshirt in heavyweight cotton-blend fabric with a printed motif and generous but not oversized silhouette. Soft, brushed inside. Ribbed crew neck, dropped shoulders, and wide, ribbed trim at cuffs and hem.
